parts.part_stem:
A battery of electromotive force (e.m.f.) $5.6\text{ V}$ and internal resistance $r$ is connected to two external resistors, as shown in Fig. 5.1.

{{figure:figure_5_1}}

Fig. 5.1

The reading on the voltmeter is $4.8\text{ V}$.

(i) Calculate:
parts.text: 1. the combined resistance of the two resistors connected in parallel

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: Show that the internal resistance $r$ is $2.5\,\Omega$.

parts.label: (b)(iii)
parts.text:
Determine the ratio
$$\frac{\text{power dissipated by internal resistance }r}{\text{total power produced by battery}}.$$

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Determine the current in the circuit.
